This creates a false equivalence and scapegoats an entire religious group for acts of violence, implying that the mere act of being offended by jokes is a justification for violence. dimensions.label: Violence-Joke Equivalence

This is a logical fallacy that ignores the complex causes of violence and instead blames a specific group for any violent outcome, regardless of context or causation.
